config.title: Configuration
config.description: Shared settings applied to every row in the grid below.
config.defaultPlatformHint: Used for newly added rows. Picking it now also fills any existing rows still set to “Other.”

sharedSettings.title: Shared session settings
sharedSettings.description: Applied to every row created from this grid. You can edit any individual class after creation.
sharedSettings.waitingRoomDescription: Turn this on to give learners early access before each class starts — they either wait in a waiting room (with an optional thumbnail and background music) or join the live class directly (Pre-Joining), depending on the Waiting Room Type you choose.
sharedSettings.lockPlaybackDescription: Applies when the class is embedded in-app.
sharedSettings.feedbackDescription: Shows the feedback form to learners after each bulk-created session ends.
sharedSettings.feedbackCompulsoryDescription: Learners cannot skip the form — all required questions must be answered.
sharedSettings.recordingDescription: These options apply to rows whose platform is Vacademy Meet. Other platforms ignore them.
sharedSettings.restrictionsTitle: Participant restrictions — the host always keeps full access
sharedSettings.disableCam: Participants can't turn on their camera
sharedSettings.disablePrivateChat: Participants can't private message each other
sharedSettings.disablePublicChat: Participants can't send messages in class chat
sharedSettings.hideUserList: Participants can't see who else is in the class
sharedSettings.endWhenNoModerator: End class after the host leaves
sharedSettings.showToLearnersOnHint: On: learners see this class and can join it like a normal live class.
sharedSettings.showToLearnersOffHint: Off: offline class. Learners won't see it or get notified; only attendance is marked.
